correctness.rationale: For nonempty A,B and positive real a,b, exposing aC_A+bC_B by u produces an intrinsic pair of summand faces. The proof separates both-positive disjoint maxima (counted by inclusion-exclusion), shared maximizing indices (one joint signed-support family), one zero maximum (full summand times simplex) and u=0. Each class has derived face dimensions, and summing gives the stated U_p,U_q,U_r generating polynomial and f0=4(pq+pr+qr)+2r. Polar support inequalities yield facets of exclusive P,exclusive S, and shared R classes, 2^p 1_{p>0}+2^q 1_{q>0}+2^n 1_{r>0}; zero-cardinality p/q/r and n=1 are handled. Independently recomputed every valid support triple through n=4 (26 cases) by exposing both signed coordinate summands to all normals from a five-value integer grid, matching total polynomial face count and vertex coefficient. No finite test is treated as an all-n proof; all-n follows from the exhaustive normal-pattern classification. A separate independent affine-rank computation recovered EVERY f-vector coefficient for all 26 valid parameter triples through dimension four; its checker enumerated exposed summand face pairs and exact rational direction ranks.
